headline: OpenAI has updated ChatGPT's voice mode with a new model, GPT-Live-1.1, that sounds more natural and adds new voices.
score_reason: Incremental product update; details differ between outlets so the voice count is not stated.
importance_line: ChatGPT users, including free users, get more natural spoken conversations, but outlets disagree on how many new voices were added.
summary: Digital Today reports that OpenAI said on Thursday it has updated ChatGPT's voice feature with its GPT-Live-1.1 voice model, which improves intonation and expression in several languages and adds two new Korean voices, "Hanul" and "Haetsal". The update also varies the phrases used while ChatGPT searches for information, and it is rolling out gradually to users worldwide, including free users.
notes: Breakingthenews page had no text; read Digital Today (Korea). Breakingthenews headline says six new voices and another outlet says 13; Digital Today says two Korean voices. No count stated in the entry because outlets disagree.
